title: Painkiller Thriller
summary: A pop singer at a retreat is found dead from an aspirin allergy. Darlene is suspected.
method: The victim didn't take the medicine from Darlene, she took medicine from another patient that was switched out to aspirin by the killer.
motive: The victim was going to leave the retreat and the killer had been stalking them and was obsessed.
notes: Darlene's episode before joining the team.
